summary.headline: Tanla's Q4 FY26 call: management says EBITDA margin (~16%) is range-bound, with GTM investment weighing; ₹12 crore FX loss flagged as non-cash.
summary.overview: Management described the EBITDA margin (about 16%) as range-bound since FY22, attributing the pressure to deliberate GTM and innovation investment, while gross margin has improved slightly over the last couple of quarters. A ₹12 crore FX loss was attributed to mark-to-market on a liability balance-sheet item (payables) and was called out separately; management is reworking its hedging policy and plans to settle the balance. Management said Bandhan Bank went live as the third ATP bank in the quarter, and that the UAE (ValueFirst international) closure, delayed for about three years, should close this quarter. Management gave no quantitative guidance, declining to share FY27/FY28 growth targets or Digital Platform mix, and said the platform revenue lag is a timing issue.

financial_highlights.change: described as range-bound since FY22; no change quantified
single-digit growth YoY per analyst; management did not dispute
from ~₹200 crore at acquisition per analyst's recollection

segments.name: Digital Platform (Wisely AI, Wisely ATP, Trubloq)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue of ₹395 crore with 98.2% gross margin; growth described as moderate because some products depend on channel-base growth, while Wisely AI is growing faster after onboarding one large global telco (Indosat). Contracts are per-subscriber-per-month, long-term (~5 years).

segments.name: Enterprise CPaaS (incl. OTT)
segments.commentary: Enterprise back on growth; OTT channel (WhatsApp >80-90% of OTT) growing fast, but analyst noted OTT share of revenue flat at ~31-32% over last four quarters. Top 250 customers contribute ~75-80% of enterprise business.

segments.name: International (UAE / ValueFirst international)
segments.commentary: Top line ~₹150-170 crore per annum at ~22% gross margin per management; transfer to Tanla teams and deal closure targeted this quarter, subject to RBI approvals.

guidance_outlook: Management expects gross margin to hold or improve marginally; EBITDA margin expected to hold or improve as GTM investments bear fruit in coming quarters.
CPaaS industry growth ~8-10% a year; management expects Tanla market share to rise, with growth 'definitely more than 10% a year'.
Capex expected to continue at ~₹100-150 crore per annum (confirmed by management).
UAE/ValueFirst international deal expected to close this quarter (management commitment).
A 'gigantic' new platform expected to be launched within about a month (per Uday Kumar Reddy).
Management declined to give FY27/FY28 growth targets for Digital Platform, stating it does not issue forward-looking statements; said it expects 'good growth' this year.
capex_capacity: Capex run-rate of ~₹100-150 crore per annum over past 3-4 years expected to continue (confirmed by CEO).
Third ATP bank Bandhan Bank went live in the quarter (one month billed in Q4); two earlier ATP deals already in place. Management declined to quantify ATP revenue per subscriber.
Recruiting people outside India for the first time to support international Digital Platform expansion.
Management did not provide capacity or utilisation data.
demand_pricing: SMS volumes growing faster than revenue; pricing under pressure, especially from banks and government segments. Management says a price reset is 'on the cards' but timing uncertain.
WhatsApp promotional messages priced ~10x utility/transactional messages; WhatsApp pushing volume toward utility, which management said may limit revenue growth per message.
OTT price correction slower and market less competitive, per management.
Wins cited: Reserve Bank of India, Bank of Baroda (new logos); a large e-commerce client's OTT wallet share rose to >50%.
Management said regulated (OTP/authentication-type) messages are a single-digit % of volumes, and sees alternate channels such as telco network APIs.
Management said PSU banks are a 'very good share' of volumes, growing; NIC is a small share of business.

qa_highlights.question: Why not pursue AI/voice acquisitions with ~₹1,000 crore cash; status of the next ATP bank?
qa_highlights.answer: CEO said Tanla is open to acquisitions but prefers build over buy given high AI valuations; third ATP bank Bandhan Bank went live last month and was integrated.

qa_highlights.question: Why was there a ₹12 crore FX loss, was it hedged, and can it be shown as a separate P&L line?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said it is a non-cash mark-to-market loss on a liability balance-sheet item; the hedging policy is being reworked and management intends to settle the balance to reduce P&L volatility. It was disclosed separately in the investor presentation; no P&L line item change was announced.

qa_highlights.question: Why have operating margins fallen since FY22 and will they stabilise near 16% EBITDA?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said margins are range-bound; gross margin improved slightly in recent quarters, while EBITDA is held down by deliberate GTM and innovation investment, which is expected to bear fruit in coming quarters.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Digital Platform growth target for FY27/FY28 and how much is contracted?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO declined to give percentages or forward-looking targets, saying the company does not issue forward-looking statements; said Wisely AI is growing much faster than traditional products.

qa_highlights.question: Why is OTT share of revenue flat at ~31-32% for four quarters despite faster OTT growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said WhatsApp growth is weighted to lower-priced utility messages as promotional traffic (~10x price) is cut, and volumes are growing faster than revenue; the market is now stabilising in its served segment.

qa_highlights.question: Status of the ValueFirst international (UAE) closure and its financials?
qa_highlights.answer: Stuck at RBI for clarifications on old matters; management committed to closing this quarter, with top line ~₹150-170 crore and ~22% gross margin, and is also exploring alternate consolidation routes.

qa_highlights.question: Will Tanla split or list the platform business separately; how is Indosat priced?
qa_highlights.answer: CEO said there are no plans to list the platform business outside India; Indosat is paid per user per month under a long-term (~5-year) subscription; subscriber-level revenue detail not disclosed, deferred to next quarter.

risks_watch: Continued SMS and bank/government price erosion; management says a price reset is possible but timing unknown.
Regulatory change making SMS non-mandatory for some alerts; management says regulated messages are a single-digit % of volumes.
Competition from in-app notifications and WhatsApp direct SME/TSP markets; management disputes material impact.
Unhedged FX liability; management says settlement is targeted to reduce volatility.
UAE/ValueFirst international closure pending RBI approval after ~3 years of delay.
Digital Platform growth is moderate despite investment; no forward targets given.
summary.management_tone: Confident on innovation, OTT wins and the UAE closure timeline, but evasive on quantitative guidance (Digital Platform targets, ATP and Indosat per-subscriber economics, FX hedge specifics), declining several questions to be addressed later. Notably, the UAE closure commitment has been repeated across calls and remains a credibility test.
key_quotes: We are reworking on our hedging policy to see if we can reduce the exposure, and it will get addressed not just by the policy, but also we're trying to settle this balance sheet item to ensure that there is a minimalistic P&L volatility in the coming quarters.
Let me commit that we will close this quarter, probably effectively around ₹150 crores to ₹170 crores top line, with around 22% gross margin is going to add to this financial year.
we don't actually issue any forward-looking statements.

growth.why: Management guided to market share gains with CPaaS industry growth of 8-10% and Tanla growth 'definitely more than 10% a year', plus 'good growth' this year, but declined FY27/FY28 targets; backing is partial (Bandhan ATP live, UAE closure committed this quarter, a 'gigantic' platform launch in about a month) with no quantified orders or capacity.
